text: A whole leaf can easily end the trip and, in my experience, may keep you from tripping for days afterward. A tiny nibble can sometimes smooth psychedelic nausea and even smooth the trip without ending it. For nausea I'd try 200mg of leaf at a time, or 10mg of the extract paste (the dried juice). But it takes only a little more than a nibble to end the trip, so I use it for nausea only when the person is okay with their trip possibly ending.
reader: someone sitting with a friend whose psychedelic trip has gone bad enough that they want it over, or whose nausea won't stop, deciding how to give beach morning glory and how much
